changelog:
- Initial release of the create-tldr-page skill.
- Requires both a documentation URL and command name to generate tldr pages.
- Strictly follows the tldr-pages template and formatting rules, including use of placeholders.
- Handles missing parameters with helpful guidance and error messages.
- Provides summary of skill usage when help flags are invoked.
- Validates that the URL points to authoritative upstream documentation before generating a page.
summary: Create a tldr page from documentation URLs and command examples, requiring both URL and command name.
